# Workflow mapping cases

Workflow files are evidence, not an importer input. Enumerate workflows by structure, inspect commands and local actions, choose a bounded check scope, and record omissions. Each mapping below is a complete v2 config accepted by the same parser; source and omission notes are kept here so mappings cannot add non-schema fields.

| Case | Fixture | Mapping | Selected scope and omissions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nonstandard names | [`nonstandard-names.yml`](../assets/workflows/nonstandard-names.yml) | [`nonstandard-names.json`](../assets/mappings/nonstandard-names.json) | The source job is `cobalt`; map its `npm run check` step to check id `review-gate` in `node:22-bookworm`. Omit the human job name and infer no other jobs. |
| Shared script | [`shared-script.yml`](../assets/workflows/shared-script.yml), [`check.sh`](../assets/source/scripts/check.sh) | [`shared-script.json`](../assets/mappings/shared-script.json) | Source command is `sh scripts/check.sh`; the reviewed fixture body runs `npm ci` and `npm run check` in `node:22-bookworm`. |
| Local composite | [`local-composite.yml`](../assets/workflows/local-composite.yml), [`action.yml`](../assets/source/local-action/action.yml) | [`local-composite.json`](../assets/mappings/local-composite.json) | Source composite command is `npm run check`; map that reviewed command to `node:22-bookworm`. Omit the action input and composite metadata. |
| Multiple workflows | [`multi-test.yml`](../assets/workflows/multi-test.yml), [`multi-release.yml`](../assets/workflows/multi-release.yml) | [`multi-workflow.json`](../assets/mappings/multi-workflow.json) | Select `multi-test.yml` job `test` and command `npm test` in `node:22-bookworm`; omit `multi-release.yml` job `publish` and `npm publish`. |
| Monorepo | [`monorepo.yml`](../assets/workflows/monorepo.yml) | [`monorepo.json`](../assets/mappings/monorepo.json) | Source command is `cd packages/frontend && npm ci && npm test` in `node:22-bookworm`; report sibling packages omitted. |
| Partial features | [`partial-features.yml`](../assets/workflows/partial-features.yml) | [`partial-features.json`](../assets/mappings/partial-features.json) | Select one `verify` run in `python:3.13-slim-bookworm`. Omit the `prepare` job's dependency installation, the Python 3.12 matrix leg, PostgreSQL service, `CI_TOKEN` secret, matrix-derived `MODE`, and the `needs` relationship; this cannot claim CI parity. |
| No workflow / manifest only | [`python-pyproject.toml`](../assets/source/manifests/python-pyproject.toml) | [`no-workflow.json`](../assets/mappings/no-workflow.json) | Manifest evidence declares pytest; install `pytest>=8,<9` before `python -m pytest` in `python:3.13-slim-bookworm`, with no workflow parity claim. |
| Python | [`python-pytest.yml`](../assets/workflows/python-pytest.yml) | [`python-pytest.json`](../assets/mappings/python-pytest.json) | Install the manifest-declared `pytest>=8,<9` before `python -m pytest` in `python:3.13-slim-bookworm`; the source setup is explicit. |
| Java | [`java-maven.yml`](../assets/workflows/java-maven.yml) | [`java-maven.json`](../assets/mappings/java-maven.json) | Map the checked-in `./mvnw -B -ntp test` command to `maven:3.9.11-eclipse-temurin-21`; wrapper presence remains a prerequisite. |
| Rust | [`rust-cargo.yml`](../assets/workflows/rust-cargo.yml), [`rust-toolchain.toml`](../assets/source/manifests/rust-toolchain.toml) | [`rust-cargo.json`](../assets/mappings/rust-cargo.json) | Map `cargo test --locked` to `rust:1.99.0-bookworm`; the toolchain fixture and a reviewed Cargo lockfile remain prerequisites. |

Matrix expansion, services, secrets, dynamic expressions, conditional needs, caches, permissions, artifacts, and deployment behavior require explicit assumptions or omission notes. A mixed-language repository uses one image containing every selected tool; v2 has one runner image.
